thread:
maria_g: Heads-up: got DSAR from EU user (LH-357) asking full data erasure incl. embeddings & chat logs. Legal says possible retention exception for a pending compliance audit. Need plan for keystore + snapshots. @legal-team
raj_patel: Ok. Did they provide proof? If legal needs hold, we need legal-hold-id. Also check if any open vuln triage or incident referencing this subject.
legal-team: They provided government ID and case ref. Putting a temporary hold request in — hold id LH-357. Not asking to block erasure yet, but need custody proof.
sophie: If hold exists, we should not delete snapshots. But we still need to prepare erasure packages and audit receipts.
maria_g: Problem: running `keystore list-snapshots --user=U123` returns 3 snapshots, one in eu-west1 and two in us-central1. The eu snapshot is encrypted with gcp-kms key projects/redwood/locations/eu-west1/keyR1.
alex_k: Also seeing older orphaned snapshot with TTL 0 flagged in backfills. We might need a forced rewrap before deletion to prove deletion success.
raj_patel: For forensics, infra-oncall may need temporary read on keystore. We can't give broad service account perms; propose create role `ad_hoc:custodian:LH-357` with timebound RBAC (1 hour) and log with audit reason.
infra-oncall: I can spin that up but need the exact principal and expiration. Also will add `audit:reason="DSAR LH-357 temporary rewrap"` to the grant.
security-bot: Automated note: granting timebound RBAC will produce an audit entry at /audit/logs with fields `actor, reason, expires_at`.
maria_g: Steps I propose: 1) Freeze write ops for U123 (deploy feature flag) 2) Create ad_hoc role + grant to infra-oncall 3) infra-oncall runs `keystore rewrap --snapshot=snap-eu-001 --to-key=projects/redwood/locations/eu-west1/ephemeral` 4) verify decryption locally 5) record logs and receipts 6) if Legal removes hold, run delete job and tombstone S3 objects 7) confirm auditproof and notify user.
alex_k: On (3) note: ephemeral key must be HSM-backed with short TTL; we'll require `--ephemeral-ttl=1h`. Also ensure KMS IAM for the ephemeral key does not include any broad groups.
legal-team: If Legal keeps the hold, do NOT delete. But prepare erasure package and signed receipt showing what would have been deleted plus snapshots retained under hold.
sophie: Edgecase: If rewrap fails due to `403: key ring permissions`, we need a breakglass path. Who has keystore-owner? @maria_g
maria_g: Currently only `keystore-admins` group and a cross-project service account. I can escalate to create temporary keystore grant but will need 2 approvers from Security.
raj_patel: Approvers: @sophie + @alex_k confirmed. Add to audit note.
infra-oncall: I’ll run the grants at 15:30 UTC. I will paste commands in thread when done.
infra-oncall: command preview:
```
gcloud kms keys versions create --key=ephemeral-lh-357 --location=eu-west1 --keyring=ephemeral-rings
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding ... --member=serviceAccount:infra-oncall@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter
```
alex_k: After rewrap, run `s3 ls s3://redwood-snapshots/user_erasure/U123/` and `keystore verify --snapshot snap-eu-001 --proof-out=lh-357-proof.json`
maria_g: Thanks. One more: we need to add a retention-exception ticket with finance and ops for the expected storage hold. I'll open JIRA PRIV-1289.
legal-team: Confirmed. If anything changes @legal-team will update LH-357 status here.
infra-oncall: Done: temporary RBAC granted, expires in 1h. Audit log: https://audit.internal/logs/entries/abcd1234 :lock:
infra-oncall: Rewrapped snapshot snap-eu-001 -> ephemeral-lh-357, ran verification, proof saved to `lh-357-proof.json` and uploaded to `s3://priv-proofs/LH-357/` :white_check_mark:
maria_g: Verified proof, shared with legal. Leaving hold open until legal says otherwise. Closing action: no deletion performed. I'll follow up with PR to add timebound-role automation.
sophie: Create follow-up runbook item to avoid manual breakglass next time. :memo:
raj_patel: thx all :eyes:
security-bot: Incident-attachment: LH-357 doc added to vault.
